title: Apical approach in periodontal reconstructive surgery with enamel matrix derivate and enamel matrix derivate plus bone subst itutes: a randomized, controlled clinical trial Moreno
authors: Rodríguez JA, Ortiz Ruiz AJ. Clin Oral Investig. 2022 Mar;26(3):2793-2805. doi: 10.1007/s00784- 021-04256-1.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “NIPSA and EMD with or without BS seem to be a valid surgical approach in the treatment of isolated, deep non -contained periodontal defects. In our study, both treatments resulted in significant PD reduction and CAL gain, that extended in the supra-alveolar component, without differences with the use of BS. Both treatments resulted in soft tissue preservation. However, the addition of BS may improve interdental papillary tissue” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
